description_en: Queries the input and output information of the current node
description_zh: 查询当前节点的输入输出信息
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-node-input-or-output --node-id 12314567 --project-env PROD --io-type output --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNodeInputOrOutput

parameters.help_en: The node ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html operation to query the node ID
parameters.help_zh: 节点的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html接口查看NodeId的相关信息
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The environment in which the node runs. Valid values: DEV (development environment) and PROD (production environment)
parameters.help_zh: 运行的环境，包括DEV（开发环境）和PROD（生产环境）
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query upstream or downstream nodes. Valid values:

input: upstream nodes.
output: downstream nodes
parameters.help_zh:
用于指定查询节点为上游节点还是下游节点。取值如下：
input，上游节点。
output，下游节点
parameters.name: io_type
